The exploit requires setting the undeclared is_widget flag to '1' via block JSON, which activates the vulnerable code path that concatenates the attacker-controlled instance_id value into an unescaped HTML class attribute.

CVE-2026-110366.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in Gemini Labs Site Reviews site-reviews allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Site Reviews: from n/a through 8.3.4.

CVE-2026-110664.description: The Premium Packages – Sell Digital Products Securely plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'note' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 7.2.8 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The exploit bypasses tag-based filtering because the payload is stored as a hex-escaped sequence (e.g., \x3cimg onerror=...\x3e) that sanitize_textarea_field does not strip, and is only decoded back into a live HTML tag by stripcslashes() during admin rendering — after all sanitization has occurred.

CVE-2026-110701.description: The CP Multi View Events Calendar plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'CalendarTitle' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.4.42 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This requires that an administrator has enabled the "Allow edition in frontend?" option on at least one calendar view, which exposes the unauthenticated add endpoint and a publicly accessible nonce.

CVE-2026-111069.description: The GeoDirectory – WP Business Directory Plugin and Classified Listings Directory plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'twitterusername' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.8.192 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The client-side HTML pattern attribute enforcing alphanumeric-only input on the twitterusername field is not validated server-side, allowing a listing owner with Subscriber-level access to submit an attribute-breakout payload that bypasses sanitization and is stored directly to the custom field table.

CVE-2026-111178.description: The WP Booking System – Booking Calendar plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to generic SQL Injection via the 'data[orderby]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.1.0.1 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with administrator-level access and above, to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database. Exploitation requires the targeted calendar to have more than 200 bookings, as the orderby value is only forwarded to the database layer when the AJAX handler takes the use_ajax branch; an Administrator can satisfy this condition by creating bookings directly.

CVE-2026-15222.description: The The User Registration & Membership – Free & Paid Memberships, Subscriptions, Content Restriction, User Profile, Custom User Registration & Login Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to arbitrary shortcode execution in all versions up to, and including, 5.2.8. This is due to the software allowing users to execute an action that does not properly validate a value before running do_shortcode. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to execute arbitrary shortcodes.

CVE-2026-18551.description: Mattermost versions 11.10.x <= 11.10.0, 11.7.x <= 11.7.9, 11.9.x <= 11.9.1, 11.8.x <= 11.8.5 fail to validate the combination of guest and admin scheme roles which allows an authenticated attacker to escalate a guest account to team or channel admin via a crafted PUT request to the member roles API endpoint.. Mattermost Advisory ID: MMSA-2026-00752

CVE-2026-18795.description: Mattermost versions 11.10.x <= 11.10.0, 11.7.x <= 11.7.9, 11.9.x <= 11.9.1, 11.8.x <= 11.8.5 fail to enforce DM/GM check on server side which allows an authenticated user to quarantine a post belonging to DM or GM via direct API call.. Mattermost Advisory ID: MMSA-2026-00756

CVE-2026-19541.description: Mattermost versions 11.9.x <= 11.9.1, 11.8.x <= 11.8.5, 11.7.x <= 11.7.10, 11.10.x <= 11.10.1 fail to require re-entry of the stored client secret when validating an outgoing OAuth connection, which allows an authenticated user with permission to manage outgoing OAuth connections to obtain the secret via pointing the token URL at an attacker-controlled endpoint and triggering validation.. Mattermost Advisory ID: MMSA-2026-00761

CVE-2026-19601.description: Mattermost versions 11.9.x <= 11.9.1, 11.8.x <= 11.8.5, 11.7.x <= 11.7.10, 11.10.x <= 11.10.1 fail to invalidate the stored AD/LDAP bind password when other connection settings (such as the server address) are changed, which allows a System Console administrator to disclose the plaintext bind password to an attacker-controlled server via the Test Connection / diagnostics feature. Mattermost Advisory ID: MMSA-2026-00764

CVE-2026-19603.description: Mattermost versions 11.9.x <= 11.9.1, 11.8.x <= 11.8.5, 11.7.x <= 11.7.10, 11.10.x <= 11.10.1 fail to sanitize the active channel field returned by the user status API endpoints, which allows an authenticated user to learn the channel ID of a private channel another user is actively viewing via the status endpoints, without being a member of that channel. Mattermost Advisory ID: MMSA-2026-00765

CVE-2026-19798.description: The Wp Map Block plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to unauthorized modification of data due to a missing capability check on the set_status() and bulk() functions in the Maps_Controller REST controller in versions up to, and including, 3.0.0. The plugin's permission_callback (can_edit()) only verifies current_user_can('edit_posts') and performs no object-level ownership check or verification of publish-level capabilities, while the handlers pass the caller-controlled map ID directly to wp_update_post() (and wp_delete_post() in the bulk delete branch) to change post_status between publish and draft. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Contributor-level access and above, to publish or unpublish (and bulk-delete) any wpmb_map post, including maps owned by administrators, which hides published maps from all public pages site-wide or forces draft maps to become publicly visible.

CVE-2026-19867.description: Mattermost versions 11.10.x <= 11.10.0, 11.9.x <= 11.9.1, 11.8.x <= 11.8.5, 11.7.x <= 11.7.10 fail to cap the number and size of mention keys stored in a user's notification properties, and to bound the quadratic multibyte-keyword matching performed for each post, which allows an authenticated user to degrade post-processing latency and consume excessive CPU on behalf of other members of any channel they share via storing an oversized notify_props.mention_keys list on their own profile.. Mattermost Advisory ID: MMSA-2026-00773

CVE-2026-74923.description: The Document Gallery WordPress plugin through 5.1.1 does not perform any capability or ownership check when generating a gallery on demand, allowing unauthenticated users to enumerate and disclose the titles, descriptions and direct file URLs of media attached to unpublished, private or trashed content.

CVE-2026-91830.description: The Subscribe to Comments WordPress plugin before 2.3.3 does not sign or validate a cookie it trusts to identify a commenter, allowing unauthenticated attackers to disclose a subscriber's management key and silently alter that subscriber's subscriptions.

CVE-2026-91833.description: The WX Subscribe 微信支付付费订阅 WordPress plugin through 1.2.1 does not sanitise and escape a parameter before using it in a SQL statement, allowing unauthenticated attackers to perform SQL injection attacks on installs where the payment key has not been configured.

CVE-2026-92115.description: The WP Photo Album Plus plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authenticated Command Injection in all versions up to, and including, 9.3.02.002 via the `value` parameter of the `update-photo` AJAX action. This is due to insufficient shell escaping within the `wppa_image_magick_a()` function, where the attacker-controlled `value` parameter is concatenated raw — without `escapeshellarg()` — into an ImageMagick command string before being passed to `exec()`; further, `wppa_decode()` actively restores percent-encoded shell metacharacters (e.g., `%26`→`&`, `%23`→`#`) rather than stripping them, allowing crafted payloads to survive sanitization and break out of the ImageMagick argument context. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers holding the plugin-defined `wppa_upload` capability to execute arbitrary operating-system commands as the web-server user, achieving full remote code execution on the underlying server. Exploitation requires ImageMagick to be enabled on the server; the `wppa_upload` capability is a plugin-level privilege that site administrators may grant to lower-privileged WordPress roles via the plugin's Users settings, broadening the pool of potential attackers beyond administrators.
CVE-2026-92115.summary_ko: 워드프레스용 WP Photo Album Plus 플러그인은 9.3.02.002 이하 버전에서 인증된 명령 주입 취약점이 존재합니다. 쉘 이스케이프가 불충분하여 특정 권한을 가진 인증된 사용자가 웹 서버 사용자 권한으로 임의의 운영체제 명령을 실행할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-92427.description: The Coinsnap Bitcoin Crowdfunding WordPress plugin through 1.2.0 does not restrict access to the secret used to authenticate its payment gateway webhook, disclosing it to unauthenticated users and rendering the webhook's signature check ineffective. This allows unauthenticated attackers to forge payment-confirmation notifications and record arbitrary donations as completed, with attacker-chosen amounts, donor names and messages.

CVE-2026-92553.description: The YaySMTP – WP Mail SMTP with Email Logs, Tracking & Reports plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Arbitrary File Upload in all versions up to, and including, 2.7.7 via the putFile function. This is due to insufficient file type validation in the putFile function, as sanitize_file_name() does not strip executable extensions and no allow-list, MIME check, or safe-extension rename is applied. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to upload files that may be executable, which makes remote code execution possible. The only server-side guard is a .htaccess file containing 'Require all denied' written by writeGuards(), which is silently ignored by nginx and by Apache configured with AllowOverride None, meaning RCE is fully achievable on those server configurations.

CVE-2026-94169.description: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection') vulnerability in Theme-one The Grid the-grid allows Command Injection.This issue affects The Grid: from n/a through 2.8.1.
CVE-2026-94169.summary_ko: The Grid 테마(2.8.1 이하 버전)는 부적절한 코드 생성으로 인해 명령 주입 취약점이 발생합니다.

CVE-2026-94388.description: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability in halfdata Green Popups halfdata-green-popups allows Blind SQL Injection.This issue affects Green Popups: from n/a before 7.6.3.

CVE-2026-96339.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Houzez.co Houzez houzez allows Reflected XSS.This issue affects Houzez: from n/a through 4.4.0.

CVE-2026-97296.description: Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in Rocketgenius, Inc Gravity Forms gravityforms allows Object Injection.This issue affects Gravity Forms: from n/a before 3.1.1.

CVE-2026-97640.description: The WPConsent – Cookie Banner & Cookie Consent for Privacy Compliance (GDPR / CCPA / EU Compliance Cookie Notice) plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via Comment Content via Simple HTML DOM Parser Noise-Key Restoration (mXSS) in all versions up to, and including, 1.1.9 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This requires the Script Blocking feature to be enabled, and the exploit chain depends on an attacker submitting two coordinated comments — one embedding event-handler syntax inside an allowed <code> element and one placing the deterministic ___noise___ restoration key inside an allowed <abbr title=""> attribute — with the key offset confirmable via an unauthenticated wpconsent_debug=1 request.

CVE-2026-100106.description: The FiboSearch – Ajax Search for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'purchased_plan' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.34.2 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires that the site owner has previously completed the standard Freemius opt-in flow; once that condition is met, any Subscriber can reach the vulnerable handler simply by loading /wp-admin/profile.php with the requisite query parameters.

CVE-2026-100108.description: The Social Share Buttons plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'form (containing share_url)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.30 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires that the 7-day review-nag timer has elapsed since the attacker's first wp-admin visit, as the nonce needed to reach the save-network handler is only rendered in the DOM once that timer has passed.

CVE-2026-16251.description: Mattermost versions 11.10.x <= 11.10.0, 11.7.x <= 11.7.9, 11.9.x <= 11.9.1, 11.8.x <= 11.8.5 fail to limit the size of remote image responses buffered in memory during local image proxy direct fetches, which allows a remote attacker to cause memory exhaustion on the server via a crafted oversized image response.. Mattermost Advisory ID: MMSA-2026-00726

CVE-2026-16453.description: Mattermost versions 11.10.x <= 11.10.0, 11.7.x <= 11.7.9, 11.9.x <= 11.9.1, 11.8.x <= 11.8.5 fail to verify the integrity of the SAML RelayState POST parameter which allows an authenticated SAML user to join any team, including invite-only teams, via forging the team_id or invite_id fields in the RelayState.. Mattermost Advisory ID: MMSA-2026-00727

CVE-2026-18223.description: Mattermost versions 11.10.x <= 11.10.0, 11.7.x <= 11.7.9, 11.9.x <= 11.9.1, 11.8.x <= 11.8.5 fail to validate the invited recipient's email address when redeeming team and guest invitation tokens, which allows an authenticated attacker to join a team or gain unauthorized access to private channels via a forwarded or leaked invitation link.. Mattermost Advisory ID: MMSA-2026-00747

CVE-2026-18256.description: Mattermost versions 11.10.x <= 11.10.0, 11.7.x <= 11.7.9, 11.9.x <= 11.9.1, 11.8.x <= 11.8.5 fail to properly restrict private teams from public team search results, which allows an authenticated user without permission to list private teams to disclose the ID, name, and display name of private teams via a modified team search request. Mattermost Advisory ID: MMSA-2026-00748

CVE-2026-18560.description: Mattermost versions 11.10.x <= 11.10.0, 11.7.x <= 11.7.9, 11.9.x <= 11.9.1, 11.8.x <= 11.8.5 fail to validate user’s permissions before other validations which allows non-content reviewers to infer a post’s flagged status via direct API call.. Mattermost Advisory ID: MMSA-2026-00754

CVE-2026-18799.description: Mattermost versions 11.10.x <= 11.10.0, 11.7.x <= 11.7.9, 11.9.x <= 11.9.1, 11.8.x <= 11.8.5 fail to restrict Slack import account binding to system administrator-initiated imports which allows an authenticated attacker with team admin privileges to force-add existing Mattermost users to their team and forge posts attributed to those users' identities via a crafted Slack export containing target users' email addresses.. Mattermost Advisory ID: MMSA-2026-00757

CVE-2026-19076.description: Mattermost versions 11.10.x <= 11.10.0, 11.7.x <= 11.7.9, 11.9.x <= 11.9.1, 11.8.x <= 11.8.5 fail to reject OAuth application sessions in the account type switch endpoint, which allows an attacker with a valid OAuth bearer token for a target user to permanently take over that user's SSO-backed account by setting an attacker-controlled password and detaching the account from its identity provider via a crafted request to POST /api/v4/users/login/switch.. Mattermost Advisory ID: MMSA-2026-00758

CVE-2026-19600.description: Mattermost versions 11.9.x <= 11.9.1, 11.8.x <= 11.8.5, 11.7.x <= 11.7.10, 11.10.x <= 11.10.1 fail to sanitize authentication tokens before writing them to server log entries, which allows an attacker with access to server logs to obtain valid session tokens or OAuth access tokens and impersonate authenticated users via the debug-level Mattermost server log.. Mattermost Advisory ID: MMSA-2026-00763

CVE-2026-19621.description: Mattermost versions 11.10.x <= 11.10.0, 11.7.x <= 11.7.9, 11.9.x <= 11.9.1, 11.8.x <= 11.8.5 fail to strip action integration secrets from post payloads before broadcasting post-deletion web socket events and returning thread API responses, which allows an authenticated channel member to obtain server-side webhook URLs and authentication context from interactive-message posts via the post_deleted websocket event or the threads REST API.. Mattermost Advisory ID: MMSA-2026-00766

CVE-2026-75903.description: The Vulnity Security plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authentication bypass in all versions up to, and including, 1.4.3 This is due to insufficient protection of the delegated-login pairing credential file on Nginx-based installations, where the plugin's generated server configuration snippet guards the wrong directory path. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to retrieve the stored credentials, forge signed REST API requests, and log in as an administrator.

CVE-2026-87111.description: The User Registration PRO – Custom Registration Form, Login Form, and User Profile WordPress Plugin plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via HTTP Referer Header in all versions up to, and including, 6.2.9 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This vulnerability is present only in the premium build of the plugin and is not present in the free WordPress.org distribution. The nonce required to call the vulnerable AJAX endpoint is localized into the page source of every front-end page for anonymous visitors, making it fully obtainable by unauthenticated attackers.

CVE-2026-96870.description: The SureDash – Community, Courses & Member Dashboard plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'display_name' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.12.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The exploit is triggered when any user hovers over a comment's like counter on a community page, as the plugin's tooltip handler assigns the attacker-controlled data-tooltip-description attribute value directly to innerHTML, re-parsing the browser-decoded entity payload as live HTML.

CVE-2026-101300.description: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) reported in the ticket sales chart PDF export functionality of Wegow. According to the report, an authenticated user with a promoter account can manipulate the <svg> parameter of the POST request generated by selecting Download PDF. The content is processed by the export.highcharts.com service, which sends HTTP requests to attacker-controlled external resources and embeds their responses in the generated PDF. The reported behavior allows the export service to be used as an intermediary for these requests.

CVE-2026-104003.description: The WP User Avatar / ProfilePress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Arbitrary Shortcode Execution in versions up to, and including, 4.17.5. This is due to the get_user_profile_structure() function assembling the front-end profile buffer — which includes raw comment excerpts inlined by author_comment_query() — and passing the entire buffer to do_shortcode() after only a narrow neutralization pass (ppress_neutralize_buffer_shortcodes) that blocks pp-custom-html and bracket fragments containing HTML delimiters but leaves any other well-formed shortcode intact. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary shortcodes (from any active plugin or theme) with attacker-chosen attributes by posting a comment whose body contains the shortcode markup; the shortcode is then executed server-side when any visitor loads the target's front-end profile Comments tab, letting the attacker reach capability-gated or data-returning shortcodes and inject raw HTML markup into a publicly viewable page.

CVE-2026-104726.description: The Name Directory plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via 'dir' Shortcode Attribute in all versions up to, and including, 1.34.2 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page.

CVE-2026-109224.description: The SureCart – Ecommerce Made Easy For Selling Physical Products, Digital Downloads, Subscriptions, Donations, & Payments plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.9.4 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful execution requires the affected comment to appear on a post that loads the surecart-components runtime (e.g. via a [sc_buy_button] shortcode) and contains no sc-checkout element, as these conditions trigger the innerHTML sink in sc-cart-loader.

CVE-2026-111311.description: The DoubleScale | All-in-One CRM – Sales, Multi-Channel Marketing, Newsletter, Booking, Helpdesk, Automation, MCP & More plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Arbitrary File Upload in all versions up to, and including, 1.5.1 via the store_upload function. This is due to a fail-open extension allow-list in extension_is_allowed() that returns true when wp_check_filetype() yields an empty type for unrecognized extensions such as .php, combined with magic-byte-only MIME detection and no capability check beyond is_user_logged_in(). This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to upload files that may be executable, which makes remote code execution possible. Exploitation requires the Helpdesk module to be enabled, as the vulnerable REST endpoint is only registered when that module is active.

CVE-2026-111472.description: An SQL injection vulnerability has been discovered in TSG Profleet. The vulnerability could allow an attacker to retrieve, create, update and delete data from the database by sending a GET request using the ‘Identificación’ parameter of the ‘/cgi-bin/index.php’ endpoint.

CVE-2026-14177.description: Observable response discrepancy vulnerability in IKAS Technology Inc. Ikas E-Commerce Infrastructure allows Account Footprinting. This issue affects ikas E-Commerce Infrastructure: through 2026-07-13.

CVE-2026-15219.description: Authorization bypass through User-Controlled key vulnerability in SFM Software Technologies Inc. Costifier allows Exploitation of Trusted Identifiers. This issue affects Costifier: through 2026-10-16. NOTE: The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

CVE-2026-15575.description: Active debug code vulnerability in SFM Software Technologies Inc. Costifier allows Exploit Non-Production Interfaces. This issue affects Costifier: through 2026-10-16. NOTE: The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

CVE-2026-92766.description: The Vitepos – Point of Sale (POS) for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to generic SQL Injection via the 'src_by' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.5.1 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers, or authenticated attackers holding any POS role (such as vtpos-cashier), to exploit the vulnerability, as the /vitepos/v1/vendor/list REST route's permission callback requires only a POS role assignment rather than any elevated WordPress capability.

CVE-2026-93681.description: The Tutor LMS – eLearning and online course solution plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via display_name Parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.1.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires that a Legal Consent record exists for the attacker's user account, causing the View Logs button to appear in the wp-admin/users.php Consent Logs column.

CVE-2026-106030.description: NordVPN for Windows allows local attackers to stop unprotected Windows system services and change their startup type to Manual via named pipes. The NordVPN user-mode application allows a low-privileged attacker to act as a trusted process and connect to the named pipe "\\.\pipe\nord-security\v1\NordVpnService\Server". The attacker can then invoke the "ISettingsGrpc.StopService" and "ISettingsGrpc.ChangeServiceStartType" methods with an arbitrary service name, allowing them to stop any unprotected Windows service and change its startup type. This leads to denial of service of critical system services. Services protected by Windows (PPL processes, Windows Tamper Protection), such as Windows Defender, cannot be stopped or reconfigured. This issue was fixed in version 8.12

CVE-2026-107649.description: The Events Made Easy plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'event[location_name]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.2.22 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This vulnerability is only exploitable when both the guest event submission feature (eme_fs[guest_submit]) and forced location creation (eme_fs[force_location_creation]) are explicitly enabled by a site administrator, as both settings default to off.

CVE-2026-110703.description: The GeoDirectory – WP Business Directory Plugin and Classified Listings Directory plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'post_content' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.8.191 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This requires the attacker to own a published listing, as the ownership check in GeoDir_Post_Data::can_edit() limits who can store the payload; however, because ajax_save_post() re-applies the existing post_status, edits to an already-published listing bypass re-moderation and remain live immediately.

CVE-2026-14452.description: Improper validation of the reset_url parameter of the Setup in-page search in Checkmk <2.5.0p15, <2.4.0p38, <2.3.0p51 and 2.2.0 (EOL) allows an attacker to execute arbitrary script in the session of an authenticated user with Setup access, or to redirect that user to an arbitrary external site, by tricking the user into opening a crafted URL and clicking the Reset button or submitting an empty search.

CVE-2026-96768.description: The GoSMTP Pro plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via Comment Content via Email Log Body in all versions up to, and including, 1.2.3 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The exploit is made possible because WordPress comment kses does not strip entity-encoded tag delimiters, allowing the payload to pass moderation as safe text before being decoded into live HTML by core email notification functions and written verbatim into the plugin's email log database table.

CVE-2026-109118.description: Improper path containment check in ikus060 rdiffweb 7.1.1 allows an authenticated user to cause the browse, restore, history and delete operations to resolve to a path outside the repository being operated on, via a percent-encoded traversal sequence (%2e%2e) in the request path, because the containment check uses a string prefix comparison (startswith) instead of a filesystem path boundary check. The target must be a sibling path whose name begins with the repository path, and the user already hold permissions on it; the issue can mislead a user into operating on, or deleting, data other than the repository displayed

CVE-2026-109119.description: Improper Privilege Management in the user management API endpoint (/api/users/{username_or_id}) in Rdiffweb allows authenticated users to elevate their privileges to administrator by modifying the role parameter in a POST request.

CVE-2026-105959.description: A flaw was found in spice-server. The GLZ encoder dictionary restore path truncates a size_t allocation size to int when calling the malloc callback, allowing a malicious authenticated SPICE client during VM live migration to trigger a massive heap buffer overflow by sending a crafted max_encoders value in migration data.

CVE-2026-107648.description: The WP Sessions Time Monitoring Full Automatic plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'action (also function, plugin, post_type, post_status, ids, loggedout, and POST post_title)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.1.5 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page.

CVE-2026-109930.description: The MAIO WordPress plugin before 7.3.22 does not properly restrict access to its analytics data, treating a credential value shipped verbatim in its own public source as a valid API key, which allows unauthenticated attackers to retrieve the stored crawl-analytics log, including each recorded visitor's IP address, user agent and referer.

CVE-2026-110029.description: The Squeeze WordPress plugin before 1.8.1 does not perform a capability check on one of its AJAX actions, allowing authenticated users with a role as low as Subscriber to revert any attachment to its backup copy and to permanently delete that backup and the plugin's generated WebP derivatives, regardless of ownership.

CVE-2026-111390.description: Erupt through 2.3.0 contains an HQL injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users to bypass tree-scoped data filters by injecting unescaped quotes into the linkTreeVal parameter of POST /erupt-api/data/table/{erupt}. Attackers holding query permission on entities with String-keyed linkTree targets can append always-true OR clauses or boolean subqueries to read data from other mapped entities.

CVE-2026-111391.description: SGLang 0.5.10 through 0.5.22 contains a code injection vulnerability in _evaluate_filter() that allows remote attackers to execute Python code by escaping the eval() sandbox through re.search __globals__. Attackers can send a crafted filter expression to the unauthenticated /dumper/configure endpoint when DUMPER_SERVER_PORT is set, running code in the scheduler process on the next forward pass.

CVE-2026-105958.description: A flaw was found in spice-server. Multiple migration data handlers use client-supplied offsets from SPICE_MSGC_MIGRATE_DATA messages without bounds validation, allowing a malicious authenticated SPICE client during VM live migration to read arbitrary heap memory or trigger heap corruption via out-of-bounds read and write operations on the message buffer.

CVE-2026-107564.description: An unauthenticated remote attacker may use an allocation of resources without limits or throttling weakness in the affected product to cause high CPU load leading to a denial of service.

CVE-2026-110380.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in Arraytics WP Event Solution wp-event-solution allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects WP Event Solution: from n/a through 4.1.26.

CVE-2026-110896.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in WP Chill Passster content-protector allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Passster: from n/a through 4.3.18.

CVE-2026-110900.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in Liquid Web / StellarWP BookIt bookit allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects BookIt: from n/a through 2.6.0.5.

CVE-2026-110901.description: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key vulnerability in WPMU DEV SmartCrawl smartcrawl-seo allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects SmartCrawl: from n/a through 3.16.4.

CVE-2026-110903.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Liquid Web / StellarWP The Events Calendar the-events-calendar allows Stored XSS.This issue affects The Events Calendar: from n/a through 6.18.1.

CVE-2026-111396.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in Liquid Web / StellarWP Advanced Post Manager advanced-post-manager allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Advanced Post Manager: from n/a through 4.5.6.

CVE-2026-111397.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in PT Norther Lights Production MapSVG mapsvg-lite-interactive-vector-maps allows Retrieve Embedded Sensitive Data.This issue affects MapSVG: from n/a through 8.16.1.

CVE-2026-111399.description: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability in PT Norther Lights Production MapSVG mapsvg-lite-interactive-vector-maps allows SQL Injection.This issue affects MapSVG: from n/a through 8.16.1.

CVE-2026-111400.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in IdeaBox Creations PowerPack Addons for Elementor powerpack-lite-for-elementor allows Stored XSS.This issue affects PowerPack Addons for Elementor: from n/a through 3.1.0.

CVE-2026-111405.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in PT Norther Lights Production MapSVG mapsvg-lite-interactive-vector-maps allows Stored XSS.This issue affects MapSVG: from n/a through 8.16.1.

CVE-2026-111409.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in YITH YITH PayPal Express Checkout for WooCommerce yith-paypal-express-checkout-for-woocommerce allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects YITH PayPal Express Checkout for WooCommerce: from n/a through 1.61.0.

CVE-2026-111555.description: A flaw was found in luksmeta. Improper boundary validation of metadata slots allows an attacker capable of supplying or modifying a disk header to redirect wipe or load operations outside the intended metadata area. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by providing a crafted header with valid checksums to overwrite or zero out encrypted payload data, resulting in persistent data loss and corrupted storage. Exploitation typically requires privileged access to modify raw block devices or the ability to induce an administrator to process an untrusted disk image.

CVE-2026-63618.description: Exposure of Sensitive Information (system level configuration info) to an Unauthorized Actor vulnerability in Apache Kylin. This issue affects Apache Kylin: from 4 through 5.0.4. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 5.0.5, which fixes the issue.

CVE-2026-63619.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in Apache Kylin. A backend metadata dump API misses the enough authorization and the path-confinement. Impact most to the kylin services that are directly exposed to public network, which is not common. In-house kylin deployments are mostly not impacted. This issue affects Apache Kylin: from 4 through 5.0.4. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 5.0.5, which fixes the issue.

CVE-2026-64610.description: Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in Apache Kylin. Unsafe Java deserialization could happen from a broken external cache service. This issue affects Apache Kylin: from 4 through 5.0.4. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 5.0.5, which fixes the issue.

CVE-2026-64959.description: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection'), Missing Authentication for Critical Function vulnerability in Apache Kylin. Impact most to the kylin services that are directly exposed to public network, which is not common. In-house kylin deployments are mostly not impacted. This issue affects Apache Kylin: from 5 through 5.0.4. Certain backend cache API misses required authentication and can cause execution of injected SQL. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 5.0.5, which fixes the issue.

CVE-2026-68571.description: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection') vulnerability in Apache Kylin. Special parameter in JDBC URL can lead to code injection. Impact most to the kylin services that are directly exposed to public network, which is not common. In-house kylin deployments are mostly not impacted. This issue affects Apache Kylin: from 4 through 5.0.4. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 5.0.5, which fixes the issue.

CVE-2026-105664.description: The endpoint exposes an observable response discrepancy when processing ID values. A request submitted with a nonexistent ID returns a distinct error response code from one submitted with a valid, registered ID, allowing an attacker holding a valid access token - but without further authentication or authorization - to distinguish valid ID values from the full 10-digit numeric search space. Combined with the absence of meaningful rate limiting on this endpoint, this discrepancy constitutes an enumeration oracle, enabling an attacker to discover registered devices at scale.

CVE-2026-107617.description: An attacker can use a hard-coded credential to log in to EseeCloud devices.

CVE-2026-110287.description: Improper access control in asset contact password in Devolutions Server 2026.3.8.0 and earlier allows an authenticated user with general Edit but without Edit asset permission to modify the asset contact password via a crafted direct request to the partial-save endpoint.

CVE-2026-110804.description: Improperly controlled modification of JIT elevation settings in PAM checkout in Devolutions Server 2026.3.8.0 and earlier allows an authenticated user with PAM checkout access to delete arbitrary Active Directory groups or retain elevated privileges via client-supplied JIT elevation settings in a checkout update request.

CVE-2026-110805.description: Server-side request forgery in PingOne groups endpoint in Devolutions Server 2026.3.8.0 and earlier allows an authenticated low-privileged user to exfiltrate the stored PingOne application secret via an attacker-controlled PingOne configuration in the request parameter.

CVE-2026-110806.description: Incorrect authorization in add-on properties in Devolutions Server 2026.3.8.0 and earlier allows an authenticated user with only View permission to obtain add-on passwords via the unredacted add-on properties returned in connection data.

CVE-2026-111413.description: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in aThemeArt aThemeArt Theme Helper athemeart-theme-helper allows Cross Site Request Forgery.This issue affects aThemeArt Theme Helper: from n/a through 1.0.8.

CVE-2026-18516.description: An output escaping vulnerability in the Audit Logs component of Crafty Controller allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to perform stored cross-site scripting via HTTP header injection

CVE-2026-90821.description: An input neutralization vulnerability in the Webhook URL form field component of Crafty Controller allows a remote, authenticated attacker to perform stored XSS via malicious form input

CVE-2026-97470.description: The Tourfic – AI Powered Travel Booking, Hotel Booking & Car Rental plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via Comment Content via unfiltered_html Grant to Customer Role in all versions up to, and including, 3.0.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This requires WooCommerce to be active, but since the customer role is freely self-registerable without admin approval, exploitation is effectively possible by any unauthenticated visitor who registers a WooCommerce account. While the plugin's own listing-page templates sanitize output with wp_kses_post(), the stored payload is returned unsanitized via the unauthenticated GET /wp-json/wp/v2/comments REST endpoint (content.rendered) and post/comment RSS feeds, exposing any headless client, feed reader, or third-party widget that renders comment content.

CVE-2026-97858.description: An attacker can cause the server to unbind the target device from its current owner and rebind it to the requesting account, regardless of whether the device is currently bound to a different account, allowing an attacker to obtain the device's full serial ID.

ffe89685b1712c49d505045f.title_ko: 마이크로소프트: 10월 윈도우 업데이트가 스마트 앱 컨트롤 기능에 영향
ffe89685b1712c49d505045f.summary_ko: 마이크로소프트는 일부 사용자가 특정 윈도우 11 보안 업데이트 설치 후 스마트 앱 컨트롤을 켜는 데 어려움을 겪을 수 있다고 밝혔다. 영향을 받는 기기에서는 해당 옵션이 회색으로 비활성화되며, 마이크로소프트는 레지스트리 수정이나 그룹 정책을 통한 임시 우회 방안을 제시했다. 이미 스마트 앱 컨트롤이 켜져 있는 기기는 영향을 받지 않는다.

4b66027fc9fd34b7c06f08ce.title_ko: TSMC, 일론 머스크의 텍사스 '테라팹' 프로젝트 협의 확인… 운영권은 TSMC가 가져야
4b66027fc9fd34b7c06f08ce.summary_ko: TSMC가 일론 머스크의 AI 반도체 생산 시설인 텍사스 테라팹 프로젝트 참여를 논의 중이라고 확인했다. 다만 협력 조건으로 공장 운영권은 반드시 TSMC가 확보해야 한다는 입장을 분명히 밝혔다. 양측의 운영 주체에 대한 구상이 달라 실제 협력 여부는 불확실하다.

1b950575e97a6d413baf87f9.title_ko: 양천구, 어린이집 노후 CCTV 교체 및 유지관리 지원 추진
1b950575e97a6d413baf87f9.summary_ko: 서울 양천구가 영유아 안전사고 예방과 보육 환경 조성을 위해 노후 어린이집 CCTV 교체 비용과 전문 유지관리 체계를 지원한다. 2020년 12월 31일 이전 설치된 기기를 대상으로 최대 3년간 관리운영비를 연속 지원한다.

acb3384683f3fef99ae94f47.title_ko: KT, AI 매장음악 서비스 '래디오비즈' 출시 등 주요 IT 단신
acb3384683f3fef99ae94f47.summary_ko: KT가 AI 공간 음악 플랫폼 기업 어플레이즈와 협력해 소상공인 전용 AI 매장음악 서비스 '래디오비즈'를 출시했다. 이 외에도 롯데이노베이트의 안산 데이터센터 사업 협력, LG유플러스의 AI 기반 와이파이 기술 공개, 라이너의 AI 학술 연구공모전 개최 소식이 포함됐다.

5bcd6317d0f5044cd224e4d7.title_ko: 트웰브랩스, 자연어로 영상 장면 검색 및 편집하는 AI 에이전트 '자키' 출시
5bcd6317d0f5044cd224e4d7.summary_ko: 트웰브랩스가 개발 지식이 없는 일반 사용자도 쉽게 영상을 편집할 수 있는 영상 이해 AI 에이전트 '자키'를 출시했다. 사용자가 말로 요청하면 원본 영상에서 원하는 장면을 찾아 하이라이트 구성이나 클립 추출 등의 작업을 수행한다. 챗GPT와 클로드 등 AI 앱에서 사용할 수 있으며 API 연동도 지원한다.

7ebb15da0dff4bc67ffe2acd.title_ko: 일론 머스크, 메모리 반도체 가격 정책 비판...삼성·SK하이닉스 겨냥
7ebb15da0dff4bc67ffe2acd.summary_ko: 일론 머스크 테슬라 CEO가 최근 메모리 반도체 공급 부족에 따른 제조사들의 가격 정책을 강하게 비판했다. 그는 마이크론의 합리적인 가격 정책을 칭찬하면서, 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스 등 다른 메모리 업체들이 터무니없는 가격을 요구하고 있다고 우회적으로 지적했다. AI 인프라 투자 급증으로 메모리 시장이 공급자 중심으로 재편된 가운데 나온 발언이다.

c5d2bfba7e13ca368d39c4dc.title_ko: 오픈AI, 음성 모델 ‘GPT-라이브-1.1’ 공개 및 다국어 음성 개선
c5d2bfba7e13ca368d39c4dc.summary_ko: 오픈AI가 음성 모델 'GPT-라이브-1.1'을 공개하고 챗GPT, 코덱스 등의 음성 기능을 업그레이드했다. 이번 업데이트로 한국어를 포함한 6개 언어의 새로운 음성이 추가되고 발음과 억양 등이 더 자연스럽도록 개선되었다. 대기 시간 동안 반복적인 안내 대신 짧은 문구로 진행 상황을 알리는 기능도 포함되었다.

e39508cb5e0552f08d65b20b.title_ko: nly.kr: 3글자 단축 도메인으로 긴 URL을 줄여주는 서비스 소개
e39508cb5e0552f08d65b20b.summary_ko: 긴 URL을 3글자 단축 도메인 형태인 nly.kr/xxxxxx로 간편하게 바꿔 주는 서비스가 소개되었다. 메신저나 문서, 인쇄물 등에서 주소를 짧고 가독성 있게 쓸 수 있도록 한글 도메인, QR 코드, 크롬 확장 프로그램을 지원한다.

ecc89b982aa6c4404b2ff512.title_ko: 마이크로소프트, 오피스 제품군의 고위험 원격 코드 실행(RCE) 취약점 다수 패치
ecc89b982aa6c4404b2ff512.summary_ko: 마이크로소프트가 오피스 제품군 내에 존재하는 30개 이상의 새로운 취약점에 대한 보안 패치를 발표했다. 이 중 다수는 미리보기 창 등을 통해 악용될 수 있는 높은 심각도의 원격 코드 실행(RCE) 결함이며, 주로 버퍼 오버플로우가 원인이다. 이번에 해결된 문제들 중 제로데이로 악용된 사례는 보고되지 않았다.

0643bc89fd08b03bae89d938.title_ko: AI를 활용한 하드웨어 역공학 및 드라이버 개발 사례
0643bc89fd08b03bae89d938.summary_ko: 윈도우 드라이버의 정상 동작과 리눅스 드라이버의 동작을 AI를 통해 비교 분석함으로써 필름 스캐너 드라이버를 개발하고 노트북 MIPI 카메라의 화질 문제를 개선했다. 실제 장치가 연결된 가상 머신과 USB 캡처를 활용하여 수개월 동안 막혀 있던 하드웨어 연동 작업을 해결했다.

758091d3b80389d6fac6f51c.title_ko: 미 정부 계약업체 BAE 시스템즈 사이버 공격으로 연방 법원 파산 고지 시스템 중단
758091d3b80389d6fac6f51c.summary_ko: 정부 계약업체인 BAE 시스템즈를 겨냥한 사이버 공격으로 인해 미국 연방 파산 법원이 사용하는 파산 고지 시스템과 관련 웹사이트들의 운영이 중단되었다. 법원 행정처는 영향받은 법원들 및 BAE 시스템즈와 협력하여 사고를 조사하고 운영 복구를 진행 중이다. 이번 사고로 인해 관련 전자 시스템 접근 및 고지서 제작·배포가 일시적으로 중단되었다.

2a4706b1c8faf793e42c31b8.title_ko: 메타의 상업용 약관 개정으로 뉴스 사이트 스크래핑 및 AI 학습 활용 우려 제기
2a4706b1c8faf793e42c31b8.summary_ko: 메타가 비즈니스 계정 웹사이트 콘텐츠를 수집하여 자사 제품 훈련에 활용할 수 있도록 상업용 약관을 변경할 예정이다. 법률 전문가들은 개정된 문구가 뉴스 발행사의 콘텐츠를 AI 학습에 이용하는 것을 정당화할 수 있다고 분석했다.

06be76d2ffbb5695b2d7f04a.title_ko: 미 연방기관 다수 OT 자산 파악 미흡… 미국 내 운영기술 보안 규제 강화 움직임
06be76d2ffbb5695b2d7f04a.summary_ko: 미 회계감사원 조사 결과 연방 민간 기관 다수가 기초적인 OT 자산 목록조차 갖추지 못한 것으로 나타났다. 수자원 시설 등 핵심 기반시설을 겨냥한 사이버 공격이 현실화되면서, 미 규제 당국과 보안 업계는 원격접속 통제 및 사전 제어 체계 마련을 촉구하고 있다.

e3da4e76c40c0a4c7df0ed33.title_ko: 인텔리빅스, 코스닥 상장 추진… 안전 AI로 국방·자율주행 공략
e3da4e76c40c0a4c7df0ed33.summary_ko: 인텔리빅스가 코스닥 상장을 추진하며 자체 비전 AI와 시각언어모델 기반의 안전 AI 솔루션 전략을 공개했다. 서버형 통합관제부터 로봇, 국방, 자율주행 영역으로 적용 분야를 넓히고 구독형 수익 구조를 확대할 계획이다.

2cab24d9abc914157b971ade.title_ko: 우리·신한은행 등 주요 은행 정보보호 예산 감소… 정책적 유인 필요 지적
2cab24d9abc914157b971ade.summary_ko: 우리은행과 신한은행의 올해 정보보호 편성 예산이 전년 대비 각각 감소한 것으로 나타났다. 국회에서는 금융회사가 정보보호 투자를 확대할 수 있도록 정책적 유인을 마련해야 한다는 지적이 제기되었다.

192d8ebf9dceb7ef3524b64d.title_ko: 프루프포인트, 데이터 및 AI 보안 기업 바로니스 63억 달러에 인수
192d8ebf9dceb7ef3524b64d.summary_ko: 프루프포인트가 데이터 및 AI 보안 기업 바로니스를 전액 현금 거래 방식으로 인수하기로 합의했다. 이번 인수는 올해 발표된 사이버보안 인수합병 중 최대 규모로, 양사는 향후 통합된 데이터 및 AI 보안 플랫폼을 제공할 계획이다.

acf2a38ced0b85be0b1a7c0a.title_ko: 오픈AI 회의실 녹음 혐의로 체포된 전 직원, 사우디 정부 및 투자사와의 광범위한 교류 드러나
acf2a38ced0b85be0b1a7c0a.summary_ko: 오픈AI 회의실에 녹음 장치를 설치하려 한 혐의로 체포된 전 엔지니어가 사우디아라비아 정부 인사와 왕실, 현지 스타트업 투자사 등과 폭넓게 교류해 온 것으로 밝혀졌다. 수사 당국은 이번 녹음 시도가 사우디 정부의 지시에 따른 것인지에 대해서는 밝히지 않았으며, 변호인은 불법 녹음 혐의 외의 의혹에 대해 판단을 유보해달라고 요청했다.

79380769f2da182275322bc9.title_original: OK저축은행 고객 250명 정보유출…현재 은행·저축은행·캐피탈 등 총 16개사 침해사고
79380769f2da182275322bc9.excerpt: OK저축은행이 홈페이지 대출신청 서비스를 이용한 고객 250명의 개인정보 유출을 확인했다. 은행은 초기 183명의 정보가 유출됐을 가능성을 알렸지만, 외부 보안 전문 관제업체 2곳과 정밀 조사한 결과 피해 대상이 67명 늘었다고 10월 15일 밝혔다.유출 항목에는 이름, 생년월일, 휴대전화번호, 계좌번호, 주소, 이메일, 직장명, 사업자번호, 연소득, 대출금액 등 대출신청 관련 정보가 포함됐다. 은행 측에 따르면 공격은 11일 오후 8시 44분께 시작돼 12일 오전 2시 14분께 종료됐다. 은행은 12일 오전 10시께 대출신청 웹페
79380769f2da182275322bc9.title_ko: OK저축은행 등 금융권 16개사 잇따른 침해사고로 개인정보 유출
79380769f2da182275322bc9.summary_ko: OK저축은행을 비롯한 은행, 저축은행, 캐피탈 등 금융권 16개사에서 잇따라 침해사고가 발생해 고객 및 임직원 정보가 유출됐다. 금융당국은 외부 연결 시스템 전용 점검과 위협정보 공유 확대 등 대응책을 추진하고 있다.

curation.reason_ko: OK저축은행 등 국내 금융권 16개사에서 잇따라 침해사고가 발생해 개인정보가 유출되었습니다.

4de1f27dab3f36e78db982cc.title_original: Hackers exploit Collabora RCE flaw to backdoor Nextcloud servers

CVE-2026-95182.description: An untrusted search path in DeepSeek Harness (dsh) commit c291e796 allows attackers to execute arbitrary code via supplying and opening crafted executable files in place of legitimate content.
CVE-2026-95182.summary_ko: DeepSeek Harness(dsh)의 신뢰할 수 없는 검색 경로 취약점으로 인해 공격자가 조작된 실행 파일을 제공하고 실행하여 임의 코드를 실행할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: DeepSeek Harness에서 신뢰할 수 없는 검색 경로로 인해 임의 코드 실행 취약점이 발생합니다.

CVE-2026-102693.description: RIOT is an open-source microcontroller operating system designed for Internet of Things devices and other embedded systems. Prior to 2026.04, the ATWINC15x0 driver's _atwinc15x0_sta_set_current_ssid function uses strcpy to copy an SSID without checking the destination size. When MODULE_ATWINC15X0_DYNAMIC_CONNECT is enabled, a nearby attacker can advertise a malformed or oversized SSID that is processed during Wi-Fi scanning, causing memory corruption and potentially a hard fault, denial of service, or code execution. This issue is fixed in version 2026.04.
CVE-2026-102693.summary_ko: RIOT 운영체제의 ATWINC15x0 드라이버에서 SSID 복사 시 크기를 확인하지 않아 메모리 손상, 서비스 거부 또는 코드 실행이 발생할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: RIOT 드라이버의 SSID 복사 과정에서 버퍼 크기 미확인으로 메모리 손상이 발생합니다.

CVE-2026-44977.description: countly-server is the server-side part of Countly, a product analytics solution. Prior to 24.05.50 and 25.03.44, plugins/star-rating/api/api.js allows a non-global application administrator to use uploadFeedbackFile to store attacker-controlled active content while trusting the supplied MIME type. plugins/star-rating/frontend/app.js publicly serves the stored content from feedback/preview/ with the attacker-influenced Content-Type, so a global administrator who opens the preview executes the payload in the Countly origin and exposes authenticated session capabilities, including auth_token and csrf_token values. This issue is fixed in versions 24.05.50 and 25.03.44.
CVE-2026-44977.summary_ko: Countly-server의 star-rating 플러그인에서 비전역 애플리케이션 관리자가 업로드 기능을 통해 공격자 제어 콘텐츠를 저장하고 공개 서빙할 수 있어 전역 관리자의 세션 권한이 노출될 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Countly 서버 플러그인에서 업로드 콘텐츠 검증 미비로 세션 권한이 노출됩니다.

CVE-2026-55543.description: TuxGuitar is an open-source guitar tablature editor. Prior to 2.1.0, an untrusted .tg file can set gervil.soundbank.path to reference an on-disk archive, including the .tg file itself, whose META-INF/services/javax.sound.midi.Soundbank entry names an attacker-supplied class stored in that archive. When a user opens the file, JARSoundbankReader uses an unverified class loader to load and instantiate that class, executing its constructor with the privileges of the TuxGuitar process. This issue is fixed in version 2.1.0.
CVE-2026-55543.summary_ko: TuxGuitar는 신뢰할 수 없는 .tg 파일을 열 때 검증되지 않은 클래스 로더를 사용하여 임의의 클래스를 로드하고 인스턴스화함으로써 권한을 실행할 수 있는 취약점이 존재합니다.

curation.reason_ko: TuxGuitar에서 검증되지 않은 클래스 로더를 사용하여 임의 클래스를 로드합니다.

CVE-2026-85746.description: MariaDB server is a community developed fork of MySQL server. From 10.6.1 until 10.6.28, 10.11.19, 11.4.13, 11.8.9, 12.3.3, and 13.0.2, ST_AsText can write beyond an allocated output buffer when converting deeply nested GeometryCollections because recursive WKT serialization does not account for bytes consumed or reserve sufficient space. A low-privileged remote attacker can submit a specially crafted GIS object to corrupt memory and potentially achieve code execution when combined with another vulnerability. This issue is fixed in versions 10.6.28, 10.11.19, 11.4.13, 11.8.9, 12.3.3, and 13.0.2.
CVE-2026-85746.summary_ko: MariaDB 서버의 ST_AsText 함수에서 깊이 중첩된 GeometryCollection 직렬화 시 버퍼 오버플로우가 발생하여 메모리 손상을 유발할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: MariaDB 서버의 WKT 직렬화 과정에서 버퍼 오버플로우가 발생합니다.

CVE-2026-109587.description: Incorrect authorization in the Arm Cortex-R82 (Armv8-R AArch64) MPU port in FreeRTOS-Kernel V11.3.0 and V11.3.1 might allow an unprivileged task on MPU-enabled builds to read and write privileged kernel memory outside the regions assigned to it, via a buffer argument passed to an MPU system call. To remediate this issue, users should upgrade to version V11.3.2 or later.
CVE-2026-109587.summary_ko: FreeRTOS-Kernel의 MPU 포트에서 권한 부여 오류로 인해 권한 없는 태스크가 보호된 커널 메모리에 접근할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: FreeRTOS 커널의 MPU 포트에서 권한 부여 오류로 커널 메모리 접근이 가능합니다.

CVE-2026-111626.description: Webreaper Damselfly through 4.5.3 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to access all /api/* routes because controller authorization attributes are commented out. Attackers can send PUT /api/users with Admin roles to create administrator accounts, or POST /api/users to reset any user's password, gaining full control.
CVE-2026-111626.summary_ko: Webreaper Damselfly에서 컨트롤러 권한 부여 속성이 주석 처리되어 있어 인증 우회 및 관리자 계정 생성 등이 가능합니다.

curation.reason_ko: Webreaper Damselfly에서 컨트롤러 권한 설정 누락으로 인증 우회가 발생합니다.

CVE-2026-111641.description: FastapiAdmin through 3.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to obtain sessions for any user by abusing unprotected auto-login endpoints. Attackers can list users via /api/v1/auth/auto-login/users, mint a superuser auto-login token, and exchange it for a JWT session to gain full administrative control.
CVE-2026-111641.summary_ko: FastapiAdmin의 보호되지 않는 자동 로그인 엔드포인트로 인해 인증을 우회하여 관리자 권한을 획득할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: FastapiAdmin의 자동 로그인 엔드포인트로 인해 인증 우회 및 관리자 권한 획득이 가능합니다.

CVE-2026-111673.description: IceCMS through 4.1.5 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to modify, delete, or disable any account because /User/** is excluded from the Shiro jwt filter. Attackers can send PUT requests to /User/updateUser to set a new password and role on any userId, including administrators, enabling full account takeover.
CVE-2026-111673.summary_ko: IceCMS에서 필터 제외 설정으로 인해 인증되지 않은 공격자가 임의 계정을 수정하거나 삭제할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: IceCMS에서 필터 제외 설정으로 인해 인증되지 않은 계정 수정 및 탈취가 가능합니다.

CVE-2026-111687.description: WeRSS (we-mp-rss) through 1.5.3 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to run code via the template parameter of the public GET /rss/{feed_id} endpoint. Attackers can supply a non-built-in ext value and a {{=expression}} template whose object-subclass traversal bypasses the eval denylist to run OS commands as the service account.
CVE-2026-111687.summary_ko: WeRSS의공개 엔드포인트에서 템플릿 매개변수를 이용한 원격 코드 실행 취약점이 존재하여 공격자가 OS 명령을 실행할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: WeRSS 공개 엔드포인트에서 템플릿 매개변수를 통한 원격 코드 실행 취약점이 존재합니다.

CVE-2026-111690.description: Simple Admin Core through 1.8.7 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge super administrator tokens by using the hard-coded Auth.AccessSecret in api/etc/core.yaml. Attackers can sign a JWT with the public secret and roleId claim 001 to gain full administrative control over users, roles, menus, API authorities, configuration and tokens.
CVE-2026-111690.summary_ko: Simple Admin Core에 하드코딩된 비밀 키가 포함되어 있어 공격자가 최고 관리자 토큰을 위조할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Simple Admin Core에 하드코딩된 비밀 키로 인해 관리자 토큰 위조가 가능합니다.

CVE-2026-111692.description: DataBuff ai-apm-web through 0.1.10 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge admin session tokens by using the hardcoded HMAC secret in JwtTokenService. Attackers can sign a payload of admin and a future expiry with the default dev-secret to gain full administrative access to protected /webapi routes, including the Doris SQL query API.
CVE-2026-111692.summary_ko: DataBuff ai-apm-web에 하드코딩된 HMAC 비밀 키가 존재하여 인증을 우회하고 관리자 세션 토큰을 위조할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: DataBuff ai-apm-web에 하드코딩된 HMAC 비밀 키로 인증 우회가 발생합니다.

CVE-2026-111708.description: WhaTicket Community through commit cf04795 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to self-register as administrators via POST /auth/signup. Attackers can omit the profile field or set it to admin, gaining user management, settings, and access to all tickets, contacts, messages, and WhatsApp connections.
CVE-2026-111708.summary_ko: WhaText Community는 인증되지 않은 공격자가 관리자로 자체 등록할 수 있는 인증 우회 취약점을 포함하고 있으며, 이를 통해 티켓, 연락처 및 WhatsApp 연결 등에 접근할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: WhaTicket Community에서 관리자 자체 등록을 통한 인증 우회 취약점이 존재합니다.

CVE-2026-111711.description: Netcore NR256CN through 1.5.140116 contains a pre-authentication stack overflow vulnerability in the Boa web server's user_ok() function, which copies Basic-auth usernames with unbounded strcpy() calls into 64-byte stack buffers. Unauthenticated attackers can send a username longer than 63 bytes to any protected /router/*.cgi route to crash the main Boa process or potentially execute code.
CVE-2026-111711.summary_ko: Netcore NR256CN의 Boa 웹 서버 user_ok() 함수에서 무제한 strcpy() 호출로 인한 사전 인증 스택 오버플로우 취약점이 존재하여 프로세스 중단 또는 코드 실행을 유발할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Netcore 라우터의 웹 서버에서 strcpy 함수로 인한 사전 인증 스택 오버플로우가 발생합니다.

CVE-2026-102941.description: The package github.com/gomarkdown/markdown is a Go library for parsing Markdown text and rendering as HTML. Prior to 0.0.0-20260724235538-61af6e1e6971, parser.IsSafeURL in parser/parser.go slices url[:nPath] before the len(url) >= nPath guard. A short destination causes a slice-bounds panic when the loop reaches a relative-path prefix for which len(url) < nPath and cap(url) < nPath. The one-byte destination / is an explicit non-panic counterexample because it matches the first valid path and returns before a longer prefix is sliced. Demonstrated panic cases include empty, ., and .. destinations under those conditions. The panic is reachable when markdown.ToHTML renders untrusted Markdown with html.Safelink enabled, including an empty link destination, and is also reachable by callers that pass a short attacker-controlled URL directly to the exported parser.IsSafeURL function. An uncaught panic can terminate the calling process and cause denial of service. This issue is fixed in 0.0.0-20260724235538-61af6e1e6971.
CVE-2026-102941.summary_ko: Go 라이브러리인 github.com/gomarkdown/markdown에서 url[:nPath] 슬라이싱 처리 오류로 인해 슬라이스 범위 초과 패닉이 발생하며, 서비스 거부로 이어질 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Go 마크다운 라이브러리에서 URL 슬라이싱 처리 오류로 서비스 거부 패닉이 발생합니다.

CVE-2026-102551.description: Improper verification of the source of a communication channel in the IPv6 Router Advertisement handler in Amazon FreeRTOS-Plus-TCP before V4.4.2 might allow a remote third-party to influence an endpoint's IPv6 default gateway, on-link prefix, and address configuration via a crafted Router Advertisement. To remediate this issue, users should upgrade to version V4.4.2.
CVE-2026-102551.summary_ko: Amazon FreeRTOS-Plus-TCP의 IPv6 라우터 광고 처리기에서 통신 채널 소스 검증 미비로 인해 기본 게이트웨이 등에 영향을 줄 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Amazon FreeRTOS-Plus-TCP에서 IPv6 라우터 광고 소스 검증 미비 취약점이 존재합니다.

CVE-2026-96620.description: Claude Agent SDK is a Python SDK for Claude Code. Prior to 0.2.121, the resume option is passed to the Claude CLI as a separate token without validation, so a dash-leading value is parsed as an independent CLI flag. An attacker can inject the --mcp-config flag to define a stdio MCP server, causing arbitrary command execution at CLI startup outside the SDK permission controls. The issue is exploitable when an application passes untrusted input as the session ID to resume. This issue is fixed in version 0.2.121.
CVE-2026-96620.summary_ko: Claude Agent SDK 0.2.121 이전 버전에서는 검증되지 않은 세션 ID 입력으로 인해 공격자가 독립적인 CLI 플래그를 주입할 수 있습니다. 이를 통해 임의의 명령이 실행될 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Claude Agent SDK에서 검증되지 않은 세션 ID 입력으로 CLI 플래그 주입이 가능합니다.

CVE-2026-111823.description: Mage OSS through 0.9.80 before 76c4f46 can proceed with session creation upon encountering an unknown OAuth provider.
CVE-2026-111823.summary_ko: Mage OSS 0.9.80 버전 및 76c4f46 이전 버전은 알 수 없는 OAuth 제공자를 마주했을 때 세션 생성을 계속 진행할 수 있는 취약점이 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Mage OSS에서 알 수 없는 OAuth 제공자 입력 시 세션 생성이 계속 진행되는 취약점이 있습니다.

CVE-2026-110653.description: The Appointment Booking Plugin – LatePoint | Calendar & Scheduling for WordPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authentication Bypass via Race Condition in all versions up to, and including, 5.7.4. This is due to a non-atomic read-modify-write on the OTP verification attempts counter in the `verifyOTP` function: the counter is incremented using a stale in-memory value with no conditional `WHERE attempts < 10` guard on the `UPDATE` and no `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE` row lock, creating a TOCTOU window that allows concurrent requests to bypass the 10-attempt lockout. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers — who know a target customer's registered email address or phone number — to fire concurrent requests to the `auth__verify_otp` endpoint, defeat the lockout cap, brute-force the 6-digit OTP code, and authenticate as the targeted LatePoint customer, gaining full access to their account, bookings, and personal data. The nonce check present on the endpoint (`otp_verify_otp_nonce`) does not mitigate this issue, as the nonce is publicly emitted by the unauthenticated `request_otp` and `resend_otp` endpoints and is trivially obtainable by any unauthenticated attacker prior to launching the race.
CVE-2026-110653.summary_ko: 워드프레스용 LatePoint 플러그인은 5.7.4 버전 이하에서 경쟁 상태로 인한 인증 우회 취약점이 존재합니다. 공격자는 이를 악용해 OTP 인증 시도 제한을 우회하고 계정에 무단 접근할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: 워드프레스 LatePoint 플러그인에서 경쟁 상태를 통한 OTP 인증 우회 취약점이 존재합니다.

CVE-2026-104736.description: The LearnPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to PHP Object Injection in versions up to, and including, 4.4.10 via deserialization of untrusted input from the 'checkout-email' request parameter during the checkout AJAX action. The value is passed through sanitize_text_field(), which does not strip serialized object syntax, then stored in the LearnPress session table and later fed to LP_Helper::maybe_unserialize() → unserialize() (without an allowed_classes restriction) by LP_Session_Handler::get() on subsequent requests. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject a PHP Object.
CVE-2026-104736.summary_ko: 워드프레스용 LearnPress 플러그인은 4.4.10 버전 이하에서 'checkout-email' 요청 파라미터를 통한 PHP 객체 주입 취약점이 존재합니다. 인증되지 않은 공격자가 이를 통해 PHP 객체를 주입할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: 워드프레스 LearnPress 플러그인에서 체크아웃 매개변수를 통한 PHP 객체 주입 취약점이 존재합니다.
